description: lightGallery version 2: the vanilla JavaScript lightbox and gallery with its plugins and the lightgallery/react, lightgallery/vue and lightgallery/angular wrappers. Version 3 is on the main branch.
rules: This is the 2.x line. The React, Vue and Angular wrappers are imported from lightgallery/react, lightgallery/vue and lightgallery/angular; the @lightgallery/* packages are version 3.
Plugins are separate entries under lightgallery/plugins/<name> and are passed in the plugins array.
Each plugin ships its own CSS under lightgallery/css/, or use lightgallery/css/lightgallery-bundle.css.
